metrics.label: New sale events
metrics.definition: Count of `property_events` rows where `event_type = NEW_SALE` within the contract date range.

metrics.label: Late sale events
metrics.definition: Count of `property_events` rows where `event_type = LATE_SALE` within the contract date range.

metrics.label: New listing events
metrics.definition: Count of `property_events` rows where `event_type = NEW_LISTING` within the contract date range.

metrics.label: Sale events in the last 30 days
metrics.definition: Rolling 30-day count of `NEW_SALE` plus `LATE_SALE` property events.

metrics.label: High-band renovation candidates
metrics.definition: Count of scored properties where `renovation_band = High` for the relevant market and time window.

metrics.label: High-band renovation candidate rate
metrics.definition: High-band renovation candidates divided by scored properties in the relevant market and time window.

metrics.label: Enrichment completion rate
metrics.definition: Succeeded enrichment jobs divided by attempted enrichment jobs in the relevant time window.

metrics.label: Town-run pass rate
metrics.definition: Share of `town_runs` rows with `status = completed` out of all runs in the selected cycle window.

metrics.label: Scored properties
metrics.definition: Count of properties with a scoring record for the selected model version and date range.

metrics.label: Source coverage share
metrics.definition: Share of observations or events attributable to a source within a source-aware comparison contract.

metrics.label: Active for-sale listings
metrics.definition: Count of properties with current_state = FOR_SALE in the relevant market and time window.

metrics.label: Median sale price (30 days)
metrics.definition: Median sale price of properties with a sale event in the last 30 days. Requires a minimum of 3 sales to be reported; null otherwise.

metrics.label: ZIP codes in target region
metrics.definition: Count of ZIP codes defined in target_regions for the relevant geography.

metrics.label: ZIP codes with tracked properties
metrics.definition: Count of ZIP codes in the target region that have at least one property in the canonical property layer.
